title: Cross-node adaptive-batcher benchmark for tensor+pipeline parallel throughput
creator: Anita Patel
description: Objective: build and run a reproducible cross-node throughput benchmark that measures tokens/sec and p95 latency for tensor+pipeline parallel configurations, and integrate regression detection and CI gating. Scope: 7B/13B/70B models, TP=1..8, PP=1..16 topologies, sequence lengths {128,512,2048}, mixed batch sizes (1..32), with and without KV cache. Testbed: Kubernetes cluster of dedicated nodes (8x A100-80GB), NVLink intra-node, RoCEv2 cross-node; isolated network perf tests performed prior to runs. Deliverables: benchmark harness (Python runner + Go load generator), perf dashboard, automated comparison job in GitHub Actions that writes results to benchmark DB, alert rules for 10% drop tokens/sec or 5% increase in p95 vs baseline. Success metrics: stable baseline established for each model+topology; regression alerts firing appropriately in internal CI; repeatable results within 3% on tokens/sec across independent runs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Harness can run a full sweep (models x TP x PP x seq_len x batch_size) in < 6 hours on the testbed and produce aggregated tokens/sec and p95 CSVs. 2) CI job runs on PRs and rejects changes that cause >10% tokens/sec regression for critical topologies. 3) Grafana dashboard with historical traces and regression annotations is live. 4) Documentation and runbook present in Confluence. 5) At least one optimization identified and implemented (e.g., improved all-reduce fusion, reduced pipeline bubble) with measurable improvement >=5%.
steps: 1) Provision dedicated benchmark namespace and nodes (infra ticket ENG-13099). 2) Run network microbenchmarks (iperf3, NCCL tests) and store baseline S3://redwood-perf/netbench/2026-03-01. 3) Prepare model artifacts (hf weights converted to sharded format). 4) Launch serving runtime in measurement mode with detailed timing hooks: token gen, kernel time, all-reduce time, pipeline idle. 5) Execute sweep runner: for each model/config, run 3 warmup runs then 10 measurement runs, capture tokens/sec, p95, 95/99 latency, GPU utilization, NVLink/PCIe counters. 6) Postprocess into summary CSV and attach to benchmark DB. 7) Run regression detector comparing to baseline using paired t-test + bootstrap; if threshold exceeded, open ENG ticket and post to #perf-alerts. 8) Publish Grafana panels and link to PR. 9) Add GH Action that triggers on PRs touching runtime/compilation code and runs a reduced smoke sweep.
comments: 2026-03-02: Kickoff with infra and model-ops. Decided to include both NVLink-only and RoCE cross-node paths to measure network sensitivity.
2026-03-04: Initial harness prototype completed (python runner + lightweight Go loadgen). Preliminary numbers for 13B (tp=2,pp=4) on seq=512: 68k tokens/sec, p95=210ms (no kv). Logged to S3.
2026-03-05: Observation from Luca: all-reduce time dominates for TP>=4 when using NCCL with default fusion; added extra profiling hooks to capture cross-node synchronization stalls.
2026-03-07: PM feedback from Mateo: ensure regression thresholds are model-topology specific; agreed to baseline per topology rather than global threshold.
2026-03-09: Infra reported intermittent RoCE packet drops impacting p95 tails; added network precheck step to the CI harness and guard to skip runs when packet loss >0.1%.
2026-03-11: Added statistical regression detector (bootstrap CI) and integrated with GH Action to post a comment on PRs with summary table + links to raw traces.
2026-03-12: Blocker from Security: need KMS-approved S3 bucket for storing raw profiling traces. Raised security_review_required and filed ENG-13130 to remediate.
